title: Robust active observation design for Earth-interior inverse problems
purpose: Test whether choosing the next measurement by expected information value improves recovery of known hidden geophysical state under a fixed acquisition budget, including when the assumed prior, measurement noise, or forward model is wrong.

notes: This benchmark evaluates experimental-design policies, not an operational geophysical monitoring network.
Model agreement or information gain alone cannot establish that a selected physical hypothesis is true.
A design can reduce uncertainty inside a wrong model while failing to discriminate that model from alternatives.

research_question: Given a finite budget of candidate geomagnetic or seismic observations, which acquisition plan most reduces uncertainty about identifiable state quantities and best discriminates competing physical/model explanations, while remaining useful under prior and observation-model misspecification?

research_basis.title: Robust A-Optimal Experimental Design for Sensor Placement in Bayesian Linear Inverse Problems
research_basis.relevance: Robust design explicitly addresses uncertainty or misspecification in priors and measurement uncertainties.

research_basis.title: Analysis and optimization of seismic monitoring networks with Bayesian optimal experimental design
research_basis.relevance: Describes sensor-network design using expected information gain and highlights sensor fidelity, Earth-model uncertainty, sensor count/type/location, and prior assumptions.

research_basis.title: Effects of geodynamo priors and geomagnetic data on inverted core surface flows
research_basis.relevance: Reports that changing the dynamo setup can strongly affect inferred core-surface motions; prior sensitivity must be measured.

research_basis.title: Submodularity of the expected information gain in infinite-dimensional linear inverse problems
research_basis.relevance: Provides a theoretical basis for greedy sensor placement in a specified class of linear-Gaussian problems; do not generalize its guarantee to nonlinear or misspecified geophysical models without proof.

scope.initial_parameters: A small, versioned low-order state vector representing magnetic-field coefficients and tangential core-surface-flow modes, with optional nuisance parameters for bias and model discrepancy.
scope.candidate_action: A proposed observation defined by modality, spatial support/geometry, time window, expected uncertainty, fidelity, data-dependence group, acquisition cost, and exact forward-operator/configuration identity.
candidate_sources: synthetic satellite or ground magnetic-field observation
synthetic observation of a published-model quantity, only as a clearly labelled comparator
initial_non_goals: claiming an optimal real-world sensor network
running a full 3D geodynamo solver as the first milestone
treating a single prior or model family as authoritative
using the held-out truth state during candidate scoring or design selection

design_policies.rule: Select valid actions at random under the same cost and feasibility constraints.
Favor spatial and temporal coverage without using inferred utility.
Maximize log determinant of a dimensionless, noise-whitened information matrix; report rank and regularization explicitly.
Minimize expected posterior covariance trace in declared parameter scales.
Maximize expected KL divergence from prior to posterior under the declared nominal model.
Optimize a declared worst-case or risk-sensitive utility over a frozen ensemble of plausible priors, noise models, and forward-model variants.
Prefer actions whose predicted observation distributions separate competing model families or discrepancy hypotheses; score against known-truth model-mismatch cases.

objective_contract.primary_utility: Expected information gain about explicitly named quantity-of-interest parameters, estimated with a declared approximation and Monte Carlo error.
separate_secondary_utilities: expected general information gain under model discrepancy
expected discrimination between competing model families
expected reduction in posterior covariance trace
objective_contract.budget_rule: Compare policies under equal total acquisition cost and the same feasibility constraints; disclose the cost model and do not combine all utilities into an opaque single score.
objective_contract.dependence_rule: Model correlated observations and shared systematic errors; duplicated or near-duplicate observations must not be counted as independent information.
objective_contract.scale_rule: Parameter scaling and observation covariance are explicit, unit-aware inputs; raw unscaled determinant values are not comparable across parameterizations.
objective_contract.uncertainty_rule: Report Monte Carlo/approximation error for estimated utilities and use paired scenario seeds for policy comparisons.

benchmark_stages.setup: Small linear-Gaussian problems with known analytic posterior covariance, planted null spaces, correlated observation noise, and a tractable exact design score.
must_show: Computed expected utility agrees with analytic reference within a preregistered numerical tolerance.
A policy cannot declare a planted null-space parameter identifiable.
Repeated runs from a frozen manifest are deterministic where the algorithm is deterministic.

benchmark_stages.setup: Deterministic low-order synthetic field/flow trajectories with versioned observation operators, incomplete spatial coverage, temporal gaps, noise, calibration bias, and known truth.
must_show: Selected observations improve the named quantity-of-interest score on held-out states or trajectories, not only on design/training cases.
The evaluation keeps truth states, candidate measurements, selected designs, and posterior/estimate artifacts distinct.
Temporal holdouts are contiguous; entire trajectory or model-family holdouts are used where possible.

benchmark_stages.setup: Generate truth under model/prior/noise variants that differ from the nominal selector assumptions; include competing physical explanations with similar nominal predictions.
must_show: Robust design is scored across all preregistered variants, including worst-case outcomes.
Model-discrimination actions are evaluated on held-out likelihood ratios or proper predictive scores.
The policy does not receive hidden truth labels, holdout residuals, or held-out forward outputs during design selection.

benchmark_stages.setup: Only after the GEO-DATA-001 payload is retrieved, independently hash-verified, parsed, licensed, and frozen, use a qualified simulation case to generate controlled observation-design scenarios.
must_show: Exact dataset version, file ID, byte digest, parser version, units, time span, and transformation identity are recorded.
Simulation truth remains labelled as simulation output, never as Earth's observed trajectory.
Real observational evaluation remains a separate later gate.

metrics.name: utility_gain_per_cost
metrics.definition: Held-out difference in expected information gain per acquisition-cost unit against each budget-matched baseline.
metrics.aggregation: paired across scenarios and seeds, with uncertainty interval

metrics.name: quantity_of_interest_recovery
metrics.definition: Bias, RMSE, and proper predictive score for predeclared state quantities after the selected measurement budget.

metrics.name: uncertainty_calibration
metrics.definition: Empirical coverage of nominal 50%, 90%, and 95% intervals and calibration/sharpness metrics over repeated known-truth cases.

metrics.name: identifiability_integrity
metrics.definition: Rank and null-space recovery on exact synthetic fixtures; count false-positive identifiability claims.

metrics.name: model_discrimination
metrics.definition: Held-out ability to distinguish planted competing model families using proper predictive scores and preregistered decision thresholds.

metrics.name: robustness
metrics.definition: Worst-case and distributional-tail utility, calibration loss, and rank stability across frozen prior/noise/forward-model perturbations.

metrics.name: compute_cost
metrics.definition: Forward-model evaluations, utility evaluations, wall-clock time, peak memory, and any stochastic approximation budget.

negative_controls: exactly duplicate a candidate observation while declaring its correlated error; information utility must not double-count it
shuffle observation timestamps while preserving marginal values
insert a sensor with no sensitivity to the target parameter
plant a parameter direction that lies in the exact observation null space
score under a prior with deliberately incorrect scale or support
generate data under a forward model absent from the selector's nominal family
attempt to leak truth labels or held-out measurements into candidate utility

aspirational_targets_not_yet_acceptance_.target: 100% correct non-identifiability handling on deterministic exact-linear null-space fixtures.
aspirational_targets_not_yet_acceptance_.qualification: Exact fixture gate, not an empirical claim about nonlinear Earth-scale inversion.

aspirational_targets_not_yet_acceptance_.target: At least 10% improvement in mean held-out utility-per-cost over the strongest simple baseline on a preregistered scenario suite.
aspirational_targets_not_yet_acceptance_.qualification: Promote to an acceptance gate only after baseline variance and scenario diversity are measured; report paired confidence intervals and calibration/non-identifiability guardrails.

aspirational_targets_not_yet_acceptance_.target: Nominal 90% and 95% interval coverage within a preregistered tolerance on adequately powered synthetic calibration runs.
aspirational_targets_not_yet_acceptance_.qualification: Publish sample size, binomial uncertainty, and per-scenario as well as aggregate coverage.

aspirational_targets_not_yet_acceptance_.target: Demonstrate robust-design utility/call-count trade-offs across at least three distinct forward-model or noise families.
aspirational_targets_not_yet_acceptance_.qualification: No single best-case model establishes robustness.

required_fields: source dataset/synthetic generator identities and versions
truth manifest digest, inaccessible to selector until scoring
policy implementation commit and configuration digest
budget, utility approximation, and numerical tolerances
per-policy/per-scenario raw metrics and aggregate uncertainty
exact code commit, toolchain, and qualification status

status_semantics.specification_not_executed: The benchmark definition exists; no results exist.
status_semantics.executed_unqualified: A run produced results but required gates or provenance are incomplete.
status_semantics.qualified_synthetic: All preregistered synthetic gates passed on the recorded exact code/configuration.
status_semantics.source_adapter_qualified: Exact simulation payload and parsing transform independently verified.
status_semantics.real_observation_evaluated: A separately defined evaluation used qualified real observations with leakage controls.

reproducibility_receipt.execution_record_rule: Emit a receipt for every attempted run, including failed, cancelled, or interrupted runs. The specification_not_executed status belongs to the benchmark contract; it is not a run receipt. Queued, skipped, cancelled, missing, or stale-head CI checks are never passes.
qualification_guardrails: Qualified statuses require a clean exact-commit worktree and a matching immutable code/configuration identity.
Every preregistered gate and negative control must pass; missing or unexecuted checks are not passes.
Truth artifacts remain withheld from the selector until scoring.
An independent verifier result must be recorded and its digest linked.
Source adapter qualification requires verified local payload bytes and passed unit, time-axis, and variable-shape audits.
Real-observation evaluation additionally requires passed leakage and reference-overlap audits.

stop_rules: Do not report an optimizer's selected design as superior if its confidence interval overlaps the benchmark's predeclared non-inferiority region.
Do not accept utility gains that come with worse interval calibration or false identifiability claims.
Do not use random adjacent-time holdouts as the only generalization test.
Do not convert missing provenance, missing noise covariance, or unqualified source payloads into defaults.
Do not report any target as achieved until a reproducibility receipt contains exact code/configuration identity and all required results.

reference_fixtures.purpose: Exact posterior/utility oracle for rank integrity and non-double-counting of highly correlated sensors.

noise_rules.independent_pair: north and east have independent errors
noise_rules.correlated_duplicate: The 2x2 error covariance for north + north_repeat_correlated is 0.25 * [[1, 0.99], [0.99, 1]].
noise_rules.utility_formula: For linear-Gaussian observations: EIG = 0.5 * ln(det(I + H^T R^-1 H)); use the full covariance R, not only its diagonal.

acceptance_checks: Analytic utility and posterior covariance match the implementation within a predeclared floating-point tolerance.
A budget-1 north-only design does not identify x_east.
The north+east design achieves rank 2 and higher expected information gain than the highly correlated north duplicate pair.
The duplicate pair uses full measurement covariance; treating its measurements as independent is a negative-control failure.
Permuting candidate input order leaves normalized selected design and score unchanged under a deterministic tie policy.
Cost-normalized EIG uses the same declared acquisition-cost model for each candidate design; the two-channel complementary and correlated-duplicate designs both cost 2.

h0_implementation_reference.compatibility_note: The complementary two-channel and correlated-duplicate Gaussian EIG values match this contract's analytic reference values under the same standard-normal prior, declared measurement covariance and unit per-channel cost assumption. This is cross-checkable analytic input compatibility, not an executed or qualified benchmark.
